newsitem.title: FRANCE: Electrafina has 10.0 pct of Suez-Lyonnaise.
newsitem.headline: Electrafina has 10.0 pct of Suez-Lyonnaise.

text.p: Belgian holding company Electrafina is the largest shareholder in French group Suez-Lyonnaise des Eaux with a 10.0 percent stake, the French group said on Thursday.

In a statement detailing its shareholders as of July 23, Suez-Lyonnaise said Credit Agricole holds 7.5 percent, Axa-UAP holds 6.2 percent, state-owned Caisse des Depots et Consignations holds 4.5 percent, glassmaker Saint-Gobain holds 4.0 percent, state nuclear company Cogema holds three percent.
Workers have 1.1 percent and the remaining 63.7 percent is widely held.
Electrafina, part of Belgian holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL), is controlled by financier Albert Frere, who has been eyeing a seat on the Suez/Lyonnaise board.
In May Frere said Electrafina's stake in the group was nine percent.
